aviation_incidents.headline: 法國軍用飛機南錫附近墜毀 機型尚未確認
aviation_incidents.summary: 一架法國軍用飛機於2026年10月20日晚在法國東北部南錫附近墜毀。Pont-à-Mousson市長Henry Lemoine表示，飛機約於當地時間23時35分在Rogéville、Domèvre-en-Haye與Tremblecourt之間墜毀。事件引發夜間搜索行動。
aviation_incidents.headline_en: French military aircraft crashes near Nancy; type not officially confirmed
aviation_incidents.summary_en: A French military aircraft crashed near Nancy in northeastern France late on October 20, 2026. Henry Lemoine, mayor of Pont-à-Mousson, said the aircraft went down at approximately 23:35 local time in an area between Rogéville, Domèvre-en-Haye and Tremblecourt. The crash prompted a major overnight search operation.

sources.name: AeroTime — French Mirage 2000D fighter jet crashes near Nancy

aviation_incidents.headline: 俄羅斯Su-30戰機加里寧格勒墜毀 機組員彈射獲救
aviation_incidents.summary: 俄羅斯國防部證實，一架俄羅斯Sukhoi Su-30戰機於2026年10月21日在加里寧格勒地區執行預定訓練飛行時墜毀。國防部表示，機組員已彈射，並由地面搜救隊尋獲；該部稱飛行員生命無虞。
aviation_incidents.headline_en: Russian Su-30 crashes during training in Kaliningrad, crew ejects
aviation_incidents.summary_en: The Russian Ministry of Defense confirmed that a Russian Sukhoi Su-30 fighter crashed in the Kaliningrad region on October 21, 2026, during a scheduled training flight. The ministry said the crew ejected and was recovered by a ground search and rescue team, and that the pilots’ lives were not in danger.

aviation_incidents.headline: 美國航空波音787在O’Hare（ORD）緊急降落，報導稱一人住院
aviation_incidents.summary: Simple Flying 的標題報導，美國航空一架波音787在 O’Hare（ORD） 緊急降落，並稱有一人住院。標題以煞車拖滯描述事件；該媒體提供的摘要則稱，機師在降落前警告可能有煞車問題，保留了問題尚屬可能性的表述。
aviation_incidents.headline_en: American Airlines Boeing 787 Makes Emergency Landing at O’Hare (ORD); One Hospitalized
aviation_incidents.summary_en: Simple Flying’s headline reports that an American Airlines Boeing 787 made an emergency landing at O’Hare (ORD) and says one person was hospitalized. The headline describes the brakes as dragging. The outlet’s summary uses more tentative wording, saying the pilots warned of a possible brake problem before landing.

taiwan_aviation.headline: 蔣萬安促中央啟動松山機場遷移規劃
taiwan_aviation.summary: 臺北市長蔣萬安赴議會報告松山機場遷移計畫等案時，再次呼籲中央現在就啟動遷移案。他表示，遷移關乎臺北及臺灣未來數十年的發展，並主張應努力面對問題、克服困難，朝目標推動。
taiwan_aviation.headline_en: Taipei Mayor 蔣萬安 urges central government to begin Songshan Airport relocation planning
taiwan_aviation.summary_en: Taipei Mayor 蔣萬安 urged the central government to begin the Songshan Airport relocation process while reporting to the Taipei City Council on the plan and other matters. He said the relocation concerns Taipei and Taiwan’s development over the coming decades, and called for efforts to address obstacles and pursue the goal.

taiwan_aviation.headline: 松山機場遷移構想待審慎評估 空勤基地尚無替代方案
taiwan_aviation.summary: 臺北市長蔣萬安宣佈規劃遷移松山機場，打造臺北人工智慧（AI）園區。內政部長劉世芳表示，空勤總隊松山基地目前沒有替代方案。她指出，空勤總隊操作直升機需要一定場地，才能支援救災、救難及醫療後送；遷移要選擇何處，須審慎評估。
taiwan_aviation.headline_en: Songshan Airport relocation plan draws scrutiny as air-service base lacks an alternative
taiwan_aviation.summary_en: Taipei Mayor 蔣萬安 announced plans to relocate Songshan Airport and develop a Taipei artificial-intelligence (AI) park. Interior Minister 劉世芳 said the Airborne Service Corps’ Songshan base currently has no alternative. She said helicopter operations need suitable space to support rescue work and medical evacuation, and that any relocation destination requires careful assessment.

taiwan_aviation.summary: 據接獲消息，中華航空Airbus A330-300客機B-18306已退租，並安排於晚間離開桃園國際機場。截稿時，尚未取得華航就該架飛機退租及後續移交安排的正式公告；退租消息與公開航跡所能確認的範圍，仍須分開看待。
taiwan_aviation.headline_en: China Airlines A330-300 B-18306 Reportedly Returned off Lease; Tracker Lists Evening Taoyuan Departure
taiwan_aviation.summary_en: Information received indicates that China Airlines Airbus A330-300 B-18306 has been returned off lease and was arranged to leave Taiwan Taoyuan International Airport in the evening. At publication, no formal airline announcement confirming this aircraft's lease return or handover arrangements had been obtained. The reported lease status should be distinguished from what public flight-tracking data establishes.

international_aviation.headline_en: FAA Issues BETA Technologies a Market-Survey Certificate for A250 eVTOL
international_aviation.summary_en: The Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) says it has issued BETA Technologies a Special Airworthiness Market Survey Certificate for its ALIA eVTOL aircraft (A250). The certificate authorizes flight operations with operators and participants for the purpose of conducting market surveys.

international_aviation.headline: 空中巴士H140完成美國高溫高海拔飛行測試
international_aviation.summary: 空中巴士直升機公司已完成新型H140直升機在美國進行的四個月飛行測試。測試讓這款雙發直升機在氣溫超過攝氏45度及海拔超過13,000英尺的條件下運作，製造商正朝認證及2028年首批客戶交付目標推進。
international_aviation.headline_en: Airbus Helicopters completes H140 hot-and-high tests in the US
international_aviation.summary_en: Airbus Helicopters has completed a four-month flight-test campaign in the United States for its new H140. The twin-engine helicopter was tested in temperatures exceeding 45°C and at altitudes above 13,000 feet. The manufacturer is working towards certification and first customer deliveries in 2028.

international_aviation.summary: 卡達航空宣佈，計畫自2027年12月15日起開通多哈與 Western Sydney International Airport（WSI）之間的直飛航班。新服務將透過多哈的 Hamad International Airport（DOH），連接卡達航空的全球航網。航空公司表示，初期將每週營運三班往返航班。
international_aviation.headline_en: Qatar Airways plans Doha–Western Sydney flights from December 2027
international_aviation.summary_en: Qatar Airways has announced plans to start direct flights between Doha and Western Sydney International Airport (WSI) on 15 December 2027. The service is planned to connect with the airline’s global network through Hamad International Airport (DOH) in Doha. Qatar Airways says it will initially operate three return services each week.

international_aviation.headline: 利雅德 King Khalid International Airport（RUH）重開 國際航班仍受限
international_aviation.summary: 利雅德的 King Khalid International Airport（RUH）於 10 月 18 日重開，結束逾一週的中斷；但國際航班仍遠未恢復正常。航空器營運人仍須事先取得沙烏地阿拉伯民航總局的起降許可。
international_aviation.headline_en: King Khalid International Airport (RUH) reopens, but Riyadh flights remain restricted
international_aviation.summary_en: King Khalid International Airport (RUH) reopened on 18 October after more than a week of disruption, but international flights remain far from normal. Aircraft operators must still obtain prior permission from Saudi Arabia’s General Authority of Civil Aviation to land or depart.

international_aviation.headline: 波音737 MAX 10取得FAA認證　最大型號補齊MAX家族陣容
international_aviation.summary: 美國聯邦航空總署（FAA）於10月20日核發波音737 MAX 10修訂型別檢定證，並授權生產，為交付航空公司鋪路。繼最短的MAX 7於今年8月獲證後，最長的MAX 10也通過審查，現有MAX家族四款主要型號的認證至此完成。
international_aviation.headline_en: Boeing 737 MAX 10 Wins FAA Certification, Completing Main MAX Lineup
international_aviation.summary_en: The U.S. Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) issued an amended type certificate for the Boeing 737 MAX 10 and authorized production on October 20, clearing the way for deliveries. Following the shortest variant, the MAX 7, gaining approval in August, the longest MAX 10 completes certification of the four main MAX variants.
